authority_rule: per PLAN_stocks_v5.md section 2/15: SEC Company Facts / Submissions are the named adoptable keyless dataset; FRED/ALFRED, FINRA and Alpha Vantage are candidates requiring an owner key/signup decision; no signup, no key, no download outside the authorized set; a fusion source is never authorized by registration, parser tests or HTTP 200

datasets: submissions (SIC, forms, filing dates for panel construction)
SEC_EDGAR.authorization_basis: named adoptable dataset in the owner plan; keyless; US-government-produced public data; fair-access policy honored (<=10 req/s, declared User-Agent)
SEC_EDGAR.redistribution: not asserted; raw files stay uncommitted (.staging_sec/ gitignored, hash-pinned)
SEC_EDGAR.deterministic_retrieval: fixed CIK URLs; two-pull equality tested at adapter level; fetch log hashes every response
SEC_EDGAR.historical_available_time: filed dates -> end-of-UTC-day conservative upper bounds; acceptanceDateTime never used as dissemination proof (frozen adapter note)
SEC_EDGAR.raw_hashes_recorded: fetch_log.jsonl sha256 per response + file_raw_sha256 in pit_records
residual_risks: date-only filed stamps overstate intraday availability by at most one session; the conditioning-lag rule (+1 session) absorbs this
current-registry panel survivorship tilt (documented in panel.json; constant across all arms)
instant-facts-only normalization in the frozen adapter V1 (duration facts skipped); V5 conditioning is instant-fact based

FRED_ALFRED.blocker: ACCOUNT_OR_KEY_NOT_AUTHORIZED - API key requires an owner signup decision (cycle instruction 2); adapter is fixture-tested only
FRED_ALFRED.v5_use: BLOCKED; no vintage macro conditioning in V5; recorded, not worked around

FINRA_SHORT_SALE.blocker: feed entitlement/signup requires an owner decision; forbidden_fields (short_interest, borrow_fee, utilization) enforce fail-closed inference guard

ALPHA_VANTAGE.blocker: key required AND not among the plan's named adoptable datasets

ECB_SDMX.note: keyless macro adapter present in the adopted frozen code; NOT named in PLAN_stocks_v5 section 2 adoptable datasets; using it would need a plan amendment

ETF_SNAPSHOT_PROVIDER_UNNAMED.note: license fields ABSENT in the snapshot (recorded, not fabricated); use bounded by prior-cycle authorization of the exact bytes; V5-P2a replay verified 37/37 byte-identical to the frozen MANIFEST

conditioning_eligibility.price_volume_only_proposals_may_use: the authorized 12-ETF snapshot fields within the non-forbidden space
conditioning_eligibility.fail_closed_rule: any arm reading a CANDIDATE/OUT_OF_SCOPE source fails closed at the data gate
